text: Hello, my partner from haiti and had to provide  a few documents from his country.. single status, qualifications documents, no criminal record etc which he got stamped and apostled. We are working with an immigration lawyer who told us that these documents dont have the correct apostle stamp but he's checking and is not able to get this particular apostle stamp. The nearest haitian consulate is in qatar so it wont be easy to go there in person. Has anyone had a by similar situation and has any advice? Thank you!
